SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT meeting.*, creator.dept_id FROM oa_schedule_event meeting JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.tenant_id = meeting.tenant_id AND creator.user_id = meeting.creator_id WHERE meeting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND meeting.event_id = #{id} AND meeting.deleted = 0
mapper.sql: deleted = 0 AND recurrence_role != 'SERIES' AND status IN ('PLANNED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND approval_status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')

SELECT * FROM oa_meeting_room WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (capacity IS NULL OR capacity >= #{capacity})
AND JSON_CONTAINS(COALESCE(equipment_tags, JSON_ARRAY()), JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))
ORDER BY room_id
SELECT * FROM oa_meeting_reminder WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_id = #{id} ORDER BY schedule_version DESC, due_time, reminder_id
SELECT id FROM oa_meeting_minutes WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(schedule_event_id, meeting_id) = #{id} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0 AND biz_type = 'OA_MEETING_ROOM' AND biz_id = CAST(#{roomId} AS CHAR) AND access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND file_type IN ('png', 'jpg', 'jpeg')
SELECT * FROM oa_schedule_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_event_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT calendar_id, calendar_name FROM sys_holiday_calendar WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY calendar_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_holiday_calendar WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT meeting.* FROM oa_schedule_event meeting WHERE meeting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND meeting.deleted = 0 AND meeting.recurrence_role != 'SERIES' AND meeting.type = 'MEETING' AND meeting.start_time < #{end} AND meeting.end_time > #{start} AND (meeting.creator_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oa_meeting_attendance invitation WHERE invitation.tenant_id = meeting.tenant_id AND invitation.schedule_event_id = meeting.event_id AND invitation.user_id = #{userId} AND invitation.deleted = 0)) ORDER BY meeting.start_time, meeting.event_id
SELECT * FROM oa_meeting_attendance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND schedule_event_id = #{id} ORDER BY user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_schedule_event SET title = #{event.title}, description = #{event.description}, start_time = #{event.startTime}, end_time = #{event.endTime}, is_all_day = #{event.isAllDay}, type = #{event.type}, room_id = #{event.roomId}, attendees = #{event.attendees}, join_url = #{event.joinUrl}, meeting_platform = #{event.meetingPlatform}, reminders = #{event.reminders}, recurrence_rule = #{event.recurrenceRule}, recurrence_end_date = #{event.recurrenceEndDate}, recurrence_exception_flag = #{event.recurrenceExceptionFlag}, source_series_version = #{event.sourceSeriesVersion}, timezone_id = #{event.timezoneId}, status = #{event.status}, approval_status = #{event.approvalStatus}, instance_id = #{event.instanceId}, expected_attendees = #{event.expectedAttendees}, buffer_minutes_snapshot = #{event.bufferMinutesSnapshot}, schedule_version = #{event.scheduleVersion}, update_time = #{event.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{event.tenantId} AND event_id = #{event.eventId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{event.version}

UPDATE oa_meeting_room SET equipment_tags = #{room.equipmentTags}, open_time = #{room.openTime}, close_time = #{room.closeTime}, bookable_weekdays = #{room.bookableWeekdays}, holiday_calendar_id = #{room.holidayCalendarId}, holiday_bookable_flag = #{room.holidayBookableFlag}, min_booking_minutes = #{room.minBookingMinutes}, max_booking_minutes = #{room.maxBookingMinutes}, advance_booking_days = #{room.advanceBookingDays}, need_approval_flag = #{room.needApprovalFlag}, approver_id = #{room.approverId}, buffer_minutes = #{room.bufferMinutes}, photo_file_id = #{room.photoFileId}, update_by = #{room.updateBy}, update_time = #{room.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{room.tenantId} AND room_id = #{room.roomId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{room.version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_dept department ON department.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND department.dept_id = account.dept_id AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = '0' JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = account.user_id JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND (role_entry.role_key = 'admin' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu grant_entry JOIN sys_menu menu_entry ON menu_entry.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id AND menu_entry.status = '0' WHERE grant_entry.tenant_id = role_entry.tenant_id AND grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND menu_entry.perms = 'workflow:task:complete'))

SELECT calendar_date.holiday_date AS date, calendar_date.date_type, calendar_date.holiday_name, calendar_date.triple_pay_flag FROM sys_holiday_date calendar_date JOIN sys_holiday_calendar calendar_entry ON calendar_entry.tenant_id = calendar_date.tenant_id AND calendar_entry.calendar_id = calendar_date.calendar_id AND calendar_entry.deleted = 0 AND calendar_entry.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE calendar_date.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND calendar_date.calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND calendar_date.holiday_date = #{date} AND calendar_date.deleted = 0
